messages:
alex: Quick sync — planning to cut the release tomorrow 17:00 UTC. Need coordinated version bumps across api, runtime, console, js-sdk (and go-sdk if anyone has time). Who's green? :clock1:
samira: API PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/214 — bumped to 0.15.0, changelog updated. CI ✅ but holding for runtime compatibility test.
ryan: Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/486 — bumped runtime to 0.15.0-rc1. Perf suite failing on a KV-cache regression, looking into it now.
leah: Console PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/122 small UI changelog and endpoint adjustments; tests pass locally, CI queued.
mike: js-sdk PR: https://github.com/redwood/js-sdk/pull/301 updated package.json -> 0.15.0, all unit tests pass. Waiting for api tag to land before I publish.
alex: Thanks. Merge/order suggestions? I want minimal rollback risk.
ryan: Suggest runtime -> api -> js-sdk -> console. Runtime has the new kernel selection behavior, API depends on that for routing tests.
samira: Agreed on order. API will pin runtime SHA in the integration test matrix, so runtime MUST be merged and tagged first.
leah: Console is mostly UI so last is fine. I can hold the changelog until everything else is tagged.
ci-bot: runtime CI failed on perf/regression tests — job 8792. Log: "kv_cache: miss rate increased 12%"
ryan: digging into it, probably introduced by the batching change from a6f3c2b -> 0f4e9d1. Reverting local patch to confirm.
alex: If runtime revert needed, we push a hotfix branch and re-run perf. We still want to keep the cutoff. If we miss the 17:00 UTC slot, next window is +6h.
mike: If runtime is delayed, I can still publish js-sdk with a soft dependency (<=0.15.0) and a note in the release; but prefer to wait for full tag.
samira: Small checklist for merge: 1) runtime green & tagged, 2) api integration tests with runtime tag, 3) merge api and create api tag, 4) publish js-sdk, 5) merge console and update docs.
ryan: Confirmed: running a perf run with reverted batching change — will post results in 15m.
leah: Also FYI — QA run on console found one e2e flake on onboarding modal (rare). I'll rerun after api tag.
ci-bot: api CI passed on PR #214, job 8810.
release-bot: Scheduled release cut window reserved: 2026-03-19T17:00:00Z by alex. Reminder 30m before cutoff.
ryan: Perf run looks good after revert (kv miss back to baseline). I'll open a small follow-up PR that reintroduces batching with a guard flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/489
samira: Nice. I'll re-run api integration tests against runtime@489-sha once merged.
mike: js-sdk ready to publish after api tag. I’ll queue the release notes and npm preflight.
alex: Final: please ping here when your PRs are merged + tag created. If any hold, call it out ASAP so we can decide whether to slip the cut. :thumbsup:
ryan: Merged runtime PR #486 -> tagged v0.15.0-rc1; follow-up PR #489 opened for guarded batching.
samira: Re-ran API integration tests against runtime@v0.15.0-rc1 — all integration tests passed. Merging api PR now.
ci-bot: api merged, created tag v0.15.0 (sha: d4f8b1a).
mike: js-sdk published as 0.15.0 to npm (dist-tag: next) — https://www.npmjs.com/package/@redwood/js-sdk/v/0.15.0
leah: Console merged and changelog updated, docs site build queued.
release-bot: Release cut done: v0.15.0 across api, runtime, js-sdk, console. Deployed to staging for canary verification.
alex: Awesome — thanks everyone. Follow-up: schedule a short retro tomorrow for the batching rollback path (15m).
